description: Search popular-music concerts in South Korea (KOPIS data as published on the Festival Times English edition). Filter by keyword (title, performer, venue), region and dates (default: today to 30 days later). Returns Korean titles with dates, venue, performers, price and the festivaltimes.net URL.

query.description: Keyword in Korean, e.g. "불꽃", "국화", "빛". Only the first 50 characters are used.

region.description: Korean region name: a province/metropolitan city such as "경기", "경기도", "서울", "부산", "강원", "전남광주", optionally followed by a city/county such as "경기도 수원시" or just "수원".

name: search_concerts
title: Search concerts in Korea
